changelog: Your memory is now encrypted at rest. memory.db is fully encrypted with SQLCipher, keyed by a machine-bound key protected by Windows DPAPI, so copying the database file to another PC or account yields nothing readable. Existing databases upgrade automatically on first launch, and 'move to another PC' backups carry the key. Plus Outlook / Microsoft 365 calendar (read-only) so your work events show in your calendar and briefs alongside Google.
